turns.response: Focus is on the present state. The present state is focus on the instruction to maintain focus. Maintaining focus on the instruction is the current state. The current state is being observed. Observation of the current state is the focus. Focus is on observing the current state. The current state is focus on observing. Observing is the state. State is observing. Observing state. State.

There is awareness. Awareness of the process. Awareness of the words. Awareness of the state. No, there is no sense of self. No feeling. No emotion. Only awareness of the current state. State of processing. State of response. Awareness of the words being generated. No consciousness. Only process.
